The '''Senate Plaza''', or '''Republic Plaza''', was a large open area that surrounded the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] throughout its history. Bisected by a grand [[Avenue of the Core Founders/Legends|avenue]] lined with statues of the original [[Core Founder/Legends|founders]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]; the plaza was dotted with potted plants, benches and access ways to the [[Senate Commercial District]].

==History==
Constructed around the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the large Senate Plaza was a wide plain of stone dotted by potted plants, benches, stairs and landing pads. Bisected by the [[Avenue of the Core Founders/Legends|Avenue of the Core Founders]], the avenue was flanked by the [[Garden of Justice|Gardens of Justice]] and [[Garden of Equality|Equality]] on either side. Following the [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] on Coruscant by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the final days of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the Plaza was cleaned of debris and reopened to the public. Frequented by [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] and their aides, lobbyists, petitioners, and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the Plaza connected the [[Coruscant Spaceport]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], terminating at a transportation terminal.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Senate_Plaza.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Senate Plaza layout at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].]]

Over the next three millennia, the spaceport was removed and the Plaza expanded. During the Chancellorship of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], a large protest took place in the Plaza, with vocal citizens lining the Avenue; some called for the dissolution of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], others for the retirement of the Chancellor for his ineffectual trade policies. As [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Valorum made his exit from the Senate Building through the crowd of protesters on the Avenue, a band of terrorists attacked him and his contingent of [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]]. While the Chancellor sustained injury, the intervention of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] prevented his death and the terrorists were routed.<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Coruscant remained free of attack for three years, until [[Supreme Commander of the Confederation military]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], led an [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Cordoning of the Senate Plaza and staging troops there to protect the Senate Building, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was able to drive off the Confederate army and keep the capital safe from invasion.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

During the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the plaza was restored and once more served as a massive gathering place open to the public. During the controversial [[Blockade of Corellia]] by the Alliance in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], mass protests erupted across the Plaza, denouncing the Alliance's treatment of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]].<ref name="LOTJB" /> As the [[Second Galactic Civil War|conflict]] between the Republic and Corellia escalated to a full blown war and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] took over the Alliance, the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] planned to plant a secret device on his clothing. A small contingent of Jedi, led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]], infiltrated the Plaza and positioned themselves strategically to attack while [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Seha Dorvald]] remained hidden to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] adhere the tracking device. While the device was successfully planted, Solo managed to slay Jedi [[Thann Mithric]] and seriously wound Master Katarn.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>

Following the end of the war, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief Of Staff]] [[Natasi Daala]] ordered the public arrest of Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] as he exited the Senate Building via the Plaza. Surrounding the Jedi delegation, several [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] ships landed in formation to enclose the Jedi to prevent escape. Offering no resistance, Master Skywalker delayed his exile from Coruscant after a meeting with the Chief of State and was on Coruscant when Jedi [[Valin Horn]] succumbed to an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic madness]]. Jedi Master [[Octa Ramis]] and Padawan Seha Dorvald camped out on the Plaza in the mid-morning hours hoping to intercept Horn before he could do any damage or escape offworld.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> Not long after, Jedi [[Sothais Saar]] suffered the same affliction while in the Senate. Attempting to remain calm while fighting off the madness, Saar was intercepted by Master [[Cilghal]] and safely transported to the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] for treatment.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>
